Sun Yat-sen was a Chinese revolutionary who played a key role in overthrowing the Qing Dynasty. The Xinhai Revolution of 1911 led to the abdication of the last emperor, Puyi, in 1912, ending the Qing Dynasty and establishing the Republic of China. This indeed ended approximately 2000 years of imperial rule in China (dating back to the Qin Dynasty in 221 BCE).
